name: Fluid DigitalDollar
oneLiner: DUSD is Fluid Finance's USD stablecoin on Arbitrum, redeemable 1:1 against USD safeguarded at regulated European banks with on-chain balance attestations.
collateral: 1:1 USD cash held in client-safeguarded accounts at regulated European banks; accounts are ring-fenced and bankruptcy-remote from Fluid Finance SA, with theft and fraud cover via Lloyd's of London. The DUSD smart contract enforces a verifiedOffchainAssetBalance ceiling so minted supply cannot exceed the attested treasury balance.
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against USD wired from a user IBAN to a Fluid Finance treasury account; an oracle publishes the safeguarded-bank balance on-chain and the contract refuses to mint above that balance. Redemption burns DUSD on-chain and credits USD back to the user's IBAN.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Fluid DUSD is tracked only on Arbitrum in Pharos, and no separate bridge route is documented for the reviewed metadata row. The route is treated as single-chain/native.

notices.title: Self-reported on-chain reserves
notices.message: Fluid Finance publishes the safeguarded-bank balance to Arbitrum via an oracle; reserves are not independently audited in real time.

mintAuthority.summary: DUSD is issued by Fluid Finance SA; mint/redeem run through the issuer's whitelisted-wallet flow against USD safeguarded at European banks, with supply capped by an oracle-published verifiedOffchainAssetBalance.

controls.label: Fluid Finance issuance + reserve-balance oracle
controls.capDescription: Contract refuses to mint above verifiedOffchainAssetBalance, an oracle-published figure controlled by the issuer reflecting the attested treasury balance.
controls.evidence: Fluid materials describe a whitelisted-wallet mint/redeem against the issuer treasury; an issuer-controlled oracle publishes the safeguarded-bank balance on-chain, and the contract caps minted supply at that balance.

controls.label: TransparentUpgradeableProxy admin EOA
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472412309, EIP-1967 proxy admin slot (0xb531…) of 0xf0b5ceefc89684889e5f7e0a7775bd100fcd3709 returned 0xdeab81c9ff7528de932890058579c0c2341f7223; eth_getCode on that address returned no bytecode (EOA). Implementation at 0xe825f4f14b93a329fbae230ef6b222f26cca4028 is deployed but unverified; the token's mint owner could not be read because owner() reverts through the transparent proxy for admin callers and the impl ABI is not published.

review.evidence: Fluid Finance SA centrally issues DUSD against off-chain USD reserves; minting is bounded by an issuer-controlled oracle (verifiedOffchainAssetBalance) and redemption burns DUSD on-chain crediting USD to the user's IBAN. No permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. The TransparentUpgradeableProxy admin is EOA 0xdeab81c9ff7528de932890058579c0c2341f7223 (Arbitrum block 472412309). The implementation 0xe825f4f14b93a329fbae230ef6b222f26cca4028 is unverified; the token's internal mint owner/role is not readable from public ABI.
unresolvedQuestions: The implementation contract 0xe825f4f14b93a329fbae230ef6b222f26cca4028 is unverified; the internal mint-capable owner/role address cannot be read. Verify or obtain the ABI to confirm the mint-surface owner before raising confidence.
